decision_table.name: Determine_MN_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Minnesota state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in MN (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets MN economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Minnesota filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: MN Stat. § 290.015 (Definitions - Doing Business) Reference: MN Form M4 Instructions (Filing Requirements)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Minnesota filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 in gross receipts to Minnesota customers.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: MN Revenue Notice 19-03 (Economic Nexus Guidance)
No Minnesota nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MN_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Minnesota state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Minnesota state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Minnesota generally conforms to the Internal Revenue Code with some modifications.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - State-specific addbacks
Subtractions may include: - State income taxes deducted on federal return - Minnesota NOL deduction (if different from federal)
Reference: MN Form M4 Instructions (Schedule M1M - Modifications) Reference: MN Stat. § 290.01 (Computation of Minnesota taxable income)
No nexus - no Minnesota state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MN_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Minnesota state corporate income tax. Applies Minnesota flat rate (9.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Minnesota state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Minnesota: × [Apportionment % - single-sales factor] 3. State additions: + [Additions from Schedule M1M] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions from Schedule M1M] 5. Minnesota taxable income: = [Result] 6. Minnesota tax rate: × 9.5% 7. Minnesota income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Minnesota credits: - [Credits] 9. Minnesota tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: MN Form M4 Instructions Reference: MN Stat. § 290.06 (Tax rate: 9.5%)
No Minnesota nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Minnesota taxable income - no tax liability. Minnesota NOL rules may apply (not implemented in basic version).
